newsitem.title: FRANCE: Eurotunnel has quorum for debt plan vote. [CORRECTED 13:51 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Eurotunnel has quorum for debt plan vote. [CORRECTED 13:51 GMT]

text.p: Channel Tunnel operator Eurotunnel SA /Plc said on Thursday enough shareholders were present at an extraordinary general meeting to allow it to go ahead with a vote on a plan to restructure 70 billion francs ($11.7 billion) of debt.
"The quorum of 25 percent has been reached," Eurotunnel executive chairman Patrick Ponsolle said at the meeting.
Shareholders need to vote on a crucial conversion deal for 70 billion francs in junior bank debt which would give banks 45.5 percent of the equity,

Before the meeting, Christian Cambier of the Eurotunnel Shareholders' Association (corrects name of association), one of the most active groups of small shareholders, said his group would vote in favour of the deal.
An earlier shareholders' meeting on June 24 failed to take a decision because the quorum was not reached. ($ = 5.959 French Francs)
